summary: Documents approval authority and evidence-traceability governance expectations for Project Nile. The document is process-only and not directly enforceable from Terraform plan JSON.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). This approval authority model does not define resource-attribute obligations that can be evaluated from resource_changes.

controls.title: Human approval required for production-impacting changes
controls.obligation: Human approval remains mandatory for production-impacting changes; automation and StackGen do not approve production changes.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON because approval actors and approval decisions are not represented in resource_changes.

controls.title: Approval requires reviewable evidence linked in GitHub
controls.obligation: Approval requires evidence that is reviewable and linked in GitHub.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON because evidence links and review records are process artifacts outside plan data.

controls.title: Governance review before promotion
controls.obligation: Governance review must occur before promotion or production-impacting progression.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON because review workflow state is not present in planned resource attributes.

controls.title: GitHub is the approval system of record
controls.obligation: GitHub is the system of record for approval evidence, review history, and decision traceability.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON because traceability records live in GitHub workflows and reviews, not resource_changes.

controls.title: Approvals must be reviewable, evidence-backed, and traceable
controls.obligation: Approvals are governance artifacts and must be reviewable, evidence-backed, and traceable through GitHub.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON because reviewability and traceability are governance process requirements rather than plan attributes.

controls.title: Production readiness approval requires evidence and human review
controls.obligation: Production readiness approval requires evidence, gate review, exception review, metadata review, validation review, and human review.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON because the required reviews and evidence types are not represented in terraform show -json output.

controls.title: Approval evidence artifacts are required where applicable
controls.obligation: PR review, governance review, validation results, exception records, metadata review, architecture review, control review, graduation evidence, and approval record are required where applicable.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON because required evidence artifacts are external approval records, not planned infrastructure fields.

controls.title: Approval rationale and history must be documented and reviewable
controls.obligation: Evidence should be linked, approval rationale should be documented, and decision history should be reviewable.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON because rationale and history are documentation artifacts outside resource_changes.

controls.title: Validation supports review but does not approve changes
controls.obligation: Validation informs approval, but validation results do not replace accountable human review and do not equal approval.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON because separation of validation and approval is a human governance responsibility, not a resource attribute check.

controls.title: Validation agents must not approve changes or exceptions
controls.obligation: Validation agents must not approve changes, production, governance exceptions, or graduation.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON because agent authorization boundaries are not modeled in terraform plan data.
